expectations.text: Includes breach/incident notification clauses with concrete timing supporting the customer's regulatory clocks (e.g., 24-72h vendor notification; GDPR 72h; DORA incident reporting support)
expectations.evidence: "notify you within a short window (e.g., 24 hours of becoming aware...)" that "supports your own DORA major incident reporting obligations to your competent authority"

expectations.text: Includes assurance rights: annual SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 evidence delivery, right to review exceptions, plus audit/access rights
expectations.evidence: "independent security certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II) and to review the underlying reports, not just certificates"; "Explicit right for you (or your appointed auditor/regulator) to audit"

expectations.text: Includes sub-processor provisions: current list, advance change notice, objection right, equivalent flow-down
expectations.evidence: "Prior written consent (or documented notice-and-object rights) before engaging new subcontractors"; "Flow-down obligation... equivalent... standards"; "a current sub-processor/subcontractor register"

expectations.text: Addresses DORA specifically for critical/important functions: Art. 30(3) enhanced provisions such as full audit and access rights (including for regulators), exit strategies/termination assistance, and notes the Register of Information (Art. 28(3)) entry
expectations.evidence: Flags "critical or important function" designation; audit rights incl. "your appointed auditor/regulator" and "cooperation with regulatory examinations"; "a documented, testable exit plan... transition assistance period"; "your regulatory ICT third-party register" (Register of Information)

expectations.text: Includes data lifecycle clauses: locations, encryption, no secondary use (e.g., no model training without consent), and return plus certified deletion with backup-expiry timeline
expectations.evidence: "Data location and data residency commitments"; "encryption at rest and in transit"; "prohibition on... use for the vendor's own model training... without explicit written consent"; "secure destruction/deletion of all copies (including backups) within a defined period... with written certification"
